scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Whoa, long time no see! But weren't you supposed to be dead?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
哇，好久不見！
不過，你不是已經死了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Ah, you must have been reborn. Well, I'm glad to have you back.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
啊，原來你轉生了。
很高興你能回來。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
I'm sorry, but I don't think you're ready to learn magic yet. Why don't you go finish learning the Basic Skills first?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
抱歉，你還沒準備好學習魔法。
不如先去把基本技能學完吧？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Take your time. The more you learn, the more ready you'll be to learn magic again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
慢慢來。
多學些東西，才能為重新學習魔法做好準備。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Well, since you have passed the Mage test once, I will not question your qualification. You want to have your magic skills back immediately, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
既然你已經通過一次魔法師考試，我就不再質疑你的資格了。
你想馬上恢復魔法能力，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wow, for some reason, you look way better than you did before. Anyway, I believe you will do a better job being a Mage as well.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
哇，不知道為什麼，你看起來比以前好看多了。
總之，我相信你也會成為更出色的魔法師。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Is there anything more I can help you with? If not, why don't you go test your skills? The world is waiting for you~!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
還有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？
沒有的話，就去試試你的本領吧。
這個世界正等著你呢~！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
What, are you interested in the Mage guild? I didn't want to tell you this, but you don't belong here.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
怎麼，你對魔法師公會感興趣？
我本來不想說的，可這裡不是你該來的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
I am not sure why you're still standing in front of me, but I can tell that you're not meant to be a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
不知道你為什麼還站在我面前，不過我看得出來，你不適合當魔法師。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yo. What's up?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
嘿，有什麼事？

scripts.text: I want to be a Mage.
scripts.translation: 我想成為魔法師

scripts.text: Tell me the Requirements.
scripts.translation: 告訴我轉職條件

scripts.text: Pretty much nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼事

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey, haven't you realized? You're aleady a Mage, silly!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
嘿，你沒發現嗎？
你已經是魔法師了，傻瓜！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey~ C'mon. Quit playing games. You can't be a Mage because you already have another Job.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
嘿~別鬧了。
你已經有其他職業，不能再當魔法師了。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh...?
Hey, look at you! You're kinda cute~! Not my type though...
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
想當魔法師啊...？
嘿，你長得還挺可愛~！
不過，不是我喜歡的型別...

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh...?
Oooh, you're such a hot babe~!
I like girls like you~
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
想當魔法師啊...？
哦，你真是個大美女~！
我喜歡像你這樣的女孩~

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
Oh, what a bummer. You haven't met the requirements yet.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
嗯？
準備好了...？
哎呀，真可惜，你還沒滿足條件呢。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
{0}'s test was...
Making Mixed Solution No. 1.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
嗯？
準備好了...？
{0}的考試內容是...
製作1號混合溶液。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
{0}'s test was...
Making Mixed Solution No. 2.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
嗯？
準備好了...？
{0}的考試內容是...
製作2號混合溶液。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
{0}'s test was...
Making Mixed Solution No. 3.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
嗯？
準備好了...？
{0}的考試內容是...
製作3號混合溶液。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Yeah? Ready...?
{0}'s test was...
Making Mixed Solution No. 4.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
嗯？
準備好了...？
{0}的考試內容是...
製作4號混合溶液。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
One of these days you'll realize the power inside of you when you can make Fire with your mind!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
總有一天，當你能憑意念生出火焰時，就會明白自己體內蘊藏的力量！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Right, you said that you wanna be a Mage? Alright then, please sign the Mage Application.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
對了，你說想當魔法師，是吧？
那就在魔法師申請表上簽名吧。

scripts.text: Sign Up.
scripts.translation: 報名

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Okay. Sign right there. Oh, you're very good at spelling. Alright. So your name is... {0}.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
好，就簽在這裡。
哦，名字拼得很準確嘛。
你的名字是...{0}。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now it's time for
me to give you the test.
Make me a ^3355FFMixed Solution No. 1^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
接下來，我來給你出題。
製作一份^3355FF1號混合溶液^000000，帶回來給我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now it's time for
me to give you the test.
Make me a ^3355FFMixed Solution No. 2^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
接下來，我來給你出題。
製作一份^3355FF2號混合溶液^000000，帶回來給我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now it's time for
me to give you the test.
Make me a ^3355FFMixed Solution No. 3^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
接下來，我來給你出題。
製作一份^3355FF3號混合溶液^000000，帶回來給我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now it's time for
me to give you the test.
Make me a ^3355FFMixed Solution No. 4^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
接下來，我來給你出題。
製作一份^3355FF4號混合溶液^000000，帶回來給我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You can find the necessary ingredients inside the Guide Book in this Guild. So you better look up what you need before you go.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
公會裡的指南手冊記著所需材料。
出發前，最好先查清楚要準備些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Once you collect all the ingredients you, use the machine in the center of the room to mix the solution. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
收齊材料後，用房間中央的機器調配溶液。
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Whaaaaat~?! Right after you tell me that you wanna become a Mage, you change your mind?! Be a bit more decisive!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
什麼~~？！
剛說完想當魔法師，你就改主意了？！
果斷一點嘛！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Go back and reach Novice Job level 9 first. Don't forget that you also have to learn all of the Basic Skills before you come back.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
先回去把初心者的職業等級練到9級。
別忘了，還要學會所有基本技能再回來。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Okay, let me
check if you made your
solution accurately...
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
好，讓我看看你的溶液配得對不對...

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey, where's the Solution
I asked for...? I can't check it if you don't show it to me, right?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
嘿，我要的溶液呢...？
不拿給我看，我怎麼檢查？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wait.
This isn't the
Solution I asked for!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
等等，這不是我要的溶液！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hmm. I can see that you tried really hard. For a beginner's attempt, this is really good.
Great work!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
嗯，看得出你很努力。
作為初學者，能做到這樣已經很不錯了。
幹得好！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 1 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
你應該製作1號混合溶液，帶回來給我。
再去試一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 2 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
你應該製作2號混合溶液，帶回來給我。
再去試一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 3 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
你應該製作3號混合溶液，帶回來給我。
再去試一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 4 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
你應該製作4號混合溶液，帶回來給我。
再去試一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Alright! I'm pleased to say that you've passed the Mage Test. I will transform you right away!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
很好！
很高興告訴你，你通過了魔法師考試。
現在就為你辦理轉職！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
*Ahem*
Congratulations!
You are now a Mage!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
*咳*
恭喜！
你現在是一名魔法師了！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
'Welcome to My World~'
Heh heh, I just wanted to say that. You know, it's a quote from a well-known movie~
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
“歡迎來到我的世界~”
嘿嘿，我就是想說這句。
這是某部著名電影裡的臺詞哦~

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Now that you're a Mage just like us, let's be friends, okay?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
現在你和我們一樣，都是魔法師了。
交個朋友吧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh?
For a cutie like you, I'd be happy to explain the requirements!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
想當魔法師啊？
你這麼可愛，我當然樂意說明轉職條件！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Wanna be a Mage, eh?
I'd be happy to explain the requirements for a pretty girl like you!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
想當魔法師啊？
為你這樣漂亮的女孩說明轉職條件，我當然樂意！

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
First of all, you have to reach Novice Job Level 10 and learn all of the Basic Skills. Then, you'll have to pass the Mage Test.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
首先，你的初心者職業等級必須達到10級，並學會所有基本技能。
然後，還要通過魔法師考試。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Your test is to
make me a
^3355FFMixed Solution No. 1^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
你的考試內容是製作^3355FF1號混合溶液^000000，帶回來給我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Your test is to
make me a
^3355FFMixed Solution No. 2^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
你的考試內容是製作^3355FF2號混合溶液^000000，帶回來給我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Your test is to
make me a
^3355FFMixed Solution No. 3^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
你的考試內容是製作^3355FF3號混合溶液^000000，帶回來給我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Your test is to
make me a
^3355FFMixed Solution No. 4^000000
and bring it back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
你的考試內容是製作^3355FF4號混合溶液^000000，帶回來給我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You can look up the ingredients you'll need to make the Solution inside the Guide Book in this Guild.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
你可以在本公會的指南手冊中檢視製作溶液所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You will be informed as to which Mixed Solution you will need to create after signing the application form.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
簽好申請表後，我會告訴你需要製作哪種混合溶液。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Let me know when you are ready to become a Mage, alright?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
準備好成為魔法師後，就來告訴我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Nothing...?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會成員]
沒什麼事...？

This machine is the property of the Geffen Mage Guild and is used only for mixing solutions for magic purposes.

本機屬於吉芬魔法師公會，僅用於調配魔法溶液。

- Proverb of the Day -
An Eye for an Eye: When you take from a person, you must replace or repay in some way.
scripts.translation:
[混合機]
- 今日諺語 -
以眼還眼：從別人那裡拿走東西，就必須以某種方式歸還或補償。

scripts.text:
[Mixing Machine]
- Proverb of the Day -
Credibility is a Man's Currency: There's a value in genuine trust that cannot be measured.
scripts.translation:
[混合機]
- 今日諺語 -

scripts.text:
[Mixing Machine]
- Proverb of the Day -
What Goes Around Comes Around: Ultimately, you will be treated in the way you treat others.
It means 'When you harm Another you will be harmed by him in an unavoidable situation'.
scripts.translation:
[混合機]
- 今日諺語 -
善有善報，惡有惡報：你怎樣對待別人，最終也會得到同樣的對待。
也就是說，傷害他人，終有一天也難免受到對方的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Mixing Machine]
- Proverb of the Day -
A good neighbor is better than a distant brother: When you need help, you can count on those close to you.
scripts.translation:
[混合機]
- 今日諺語 -
遠親不如近鄰：當你需要幫助時，可以依靠身邊的人。

scripts.text:
[Mixing Machine]
- Proverb of the Day -
Birds of a Feather Flock Together: You can look at a person's friends as an indicator of their character.
scripts.translation:
[混合機]
- 今日諺語 -
物以類聚，人以群分：看一個人交什麼朋友，就能大致瞭解他的品格。
